content_sections.heading: About DCCM Nilgiris
content_sections.text: The District Climate Change Mission (DCCM) is the district-level climate mission of The Nilgiris district in Tamil Nadu, working with the Department of Environment and Climate Change (DoE&CC) of the Tamil Nadu Government at the State level. The Technical Assistant post is being filled under G.O. (2D) No.144, dated 16.09.2026, released by the Department of Environment and Climate Change, Tamil Nadu Government. Its office for applications is at the District Forest Office, Nilgiris Division, Ooty.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice allows two ways to apply. Eligible and interested candidates may send their updated CV/Resume: By email to [email protected] By post to District Climate Change Mission, District Forest Office, Nilgiris Division, Ooty- 643001 The application must be sent on or before 9 November 2026 . The notice does not prescribe an application form, an email subject line or any wording for the envelope. The Tamil version of the notice asks applicants to send the updated Resume/CV with details of their educational qualification and work experience, and names only the email route.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one Technical Assistant post, offered on contract basis. As per the G.O., a job period of 19 months is allotted for the post. Undergraduate Degree in the field of Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy and Similar Fields. Basic Type Writing skills in both Tamil and English. The Tamil version of the notice also lists basic computer knowledge and skills in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint as necessary. Experience is not compulsory. Candidates who have work experience for at least one year may be given first priority. Candidates must be residents of the Nilgiris district. A candidate may not exceed the age of 40 while applying for the post of Technical Assistant. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. In addition to the monthly pay, a travel allowance of Rs.25,000 per year is provided. The Tamil version describes this as a travel head for official travel connected with the mission's environment and climate change work, as per Government rules. For the full wording of the eligibility conditions, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Nilgiris Technical Assistant-1 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these roles and responsibilities for the Technical Assistant: Promote coordination and synergy among line departments for effective environmental protection and climate action. Coordinate DCCM activities, organize capacity-building programmes and document successful climate initiatives. Act as a link between DoE&CC at the State level and the District Climate Change Mission at district level. Conduct DCCM Meetings once every two months and submit the Minutes of Meeting to the Government through the Director, DoE&CC within 15 days. Review innovation, monitor existing schemes and plan upcoming activities and stakeholder engagement during each meeting. Maintaining Government records. The Tamil version also mentions collecting climate change and environment data, preparing reports, official letters, statistics and PowerPoint presentations, coordinating meetings, trainings, seminars and awareness programmes, and carrying out work assigned by the District Climate Officer/Director.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Updated CV/Resume Details of educational qualification and work experience (named in the Tamil version of the notice)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The English notice lists the selection method in this order: Applicant Eligibility verification Typing test Written test & Interview The notice does not give the date, venue, syllabus or marks for the typing test, written test or interview. The Tamil version lists the same stages, with the written test/interview before the typing test.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The post is on contract basis for a job period of 19 months, as allotted in the G.O. The Technical Assistant shall be allowed to avail one-day leave per month, subject to prior permission from the nodal officer of the district. One-month yearly notice by the Technical Assistant is required for the termination of the post. The chairperson is entitled to relieve the candidate at any point during the notice period. Postings are at the District Forest Office, Nilgiris Division and the District Collector Office, The Nilgiris.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DCCM Nilgiris Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 Technical Assistant post on contract basis with the District Climate Change Mission, The Nilgiris district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DCCM Nilgiris Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: An Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy or similar fields, with basic typewriting skills in both Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DCCM Nilgiris Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: A candidate may not exceed the age of 40 while applying.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.22,000 per month, along with a travel allowance of Rs.25,000 per year.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for DCCM Nilgiris Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Mail your updated CV/Resume to [email protected] or post it to District Climate Change Mission, District Forest Office, Nilgiris Division, Ooty- 643001, on or before 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selection involves applicant eligibility verification, a typing test, and a written test and interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DCCM Nilgiris Technical Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is on contract basis, and the G.O. allots a job period of 19 months.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside the Nilgiris district apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates must be residents of the Nilgiris district.

faq.question: Q10. Is work experience required for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Experience is not compulsory, but candidates with at least one year of work experience may be given first priority.
